result.summary: Independently re-verified lib/letflow/design/req030-definition-store-crud.md against docs/requirements.yaml's actual REQ-030 entry (read in full, lines 1339-1418), R-Co's src/design/definition.md (lines 550-600, read directly), Letflow.TenantProvisioning (lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex, full file) and Letflow.Definitions.Graph (lib/letflow/definitions/graph.ex, lines 155-224). All checks pass. (1) Acceptance-criteria count: docs/requirements.yaml's REQ-030 acceptance_criteria list has exactly 9 entries (lines 1409-1417), confirming CODE-DESIGNER's 9-not-8 claim independently; the design's Section 11 traceability table maps all 9 to concrete design elements, no TBD/deferral language found (grep clean). (2) All 7 function signatures (create/2, get_by_id/2, get_active_by_name/2, list/2, activate/2, deprecate/2, archive/2) carry full @spec blocks with every error case as a tagged atom/tuple and a consistent {:ok,_}|{:error,_} shape; no bare def/defp/do-end function bodies present anywhere in the doc (grep confirmed) -- the embedded Ecto pipe-chain fragments are algorithm-shape illustrations within numbered steps, consistent with the established req024/req025 pseudocode convention, not complete implementations. (3) Cross-module dependencies listed in Section 10. (4) tenant_id derivation VERIFIED CORRECT: TenantProvisioning.tenant_id_for_schema_name/1's real contract (tenant_provisioning.ex:100-115) is total, pattern-matches 'tenant_'<>32-hex, returns {:ok, tenant_id}|{:error, :invalid_schema_name} -- the design's Section 3 usage (deriving tenant_id from opts[:prefix], rejecting any caller-supplied :tenant_id/'tenant_id' key outright rather than silently overriding) is a correct, consistent application, not a reinvention. (5) PD-04 transition-table claim VERIFIED CORRECT: definition.md's authoritative table (read directly) has exactly 3 permitted edges, 4 diagonal not-applicable cells, and 9 '✗ HTTP 409' forbidden cells -- confirming CODE-DESIGNER's 9-not-4 claim against AC5's literal '4 forbidden-transition cells' wording. Traced the design's own enforcement mechanism (Section 6.1-6.3): activate/2's guard rejects 2 of the 9 (DEPRECATED->ACTIVE, ARCHIVED->ACTIVE) as :not_draft; deprecate/2's exact-match WHERE rejects 2 more (DRAFT->DEPRECATED, ARCHIVED->DEPRECATED); archive/2's exact-match WHERE rejects 2 more (DRAFT->ARCHIVED, ACTIVE->ARCHIVED); the remaining 3 (X->DRAFT) are vacuously unreachable since no function in this design ever writes status back to :draft. All 9 are genuinely covered, not just the 4 AC5's text names. (6) REQ-029 validator-gap claim VERIFIED CORRECT: lib/letflow/definitions/graph.ex confirms validate_graph/1 (line 162), validate_node_attributes/1 (line 188), and validate_edge_conditions/1 (line 212) all exist as real shipped functions with the identical result() shape; the design's create/2 pipeline (Section 4.1, steps P7/P8/P9) calls all three in sequence, closing the gap that REQ-030's own requirements.yaml description text names only validateNodeAttributes by name.
